about: P@x's keyboard commands: the one source of the keys P@x's indicator shows and of the bindings that make them work (desktop-experience.md, 17.1, answer 2: the stop combination is visible at all times while P@x is on, and the full list is one action away from the indicator). gen_commands.py turns this file into PaxCommands.qml for the programs that show the keys; a program that binds a key (a desktop file's X-KDE-Shortcuts, a global-shortcut registration) takes it from here, and gen_commands.py --check fails if a binding file in the repository disagrees with this one. 'bound' says whether a shipped file binds the key (the image does not install the desktop programs yet, issue #59). 'verified' says whether the key was checked to be free in Plasma 6.8's defaults.

commands.boundBy: the stop control: for now a global shortcut, the action "stop" of tur-pax-ui's desktop file (X-KDE-Shortcuts), which runs tur-pax-ui --stop (task D-17); later the physical input witness (design 9.8; owner's answer 17.1.2)
tur-pax-ui's desktop file, X-KDE-Shortcuts (design 9.1; task D-17)
